name: ibeji-app
description: Ìbejì — the companion window. A client of the daemon's local HTTP API.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node test/pairing-guard.js snapshot && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= ./node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron test/smoke.js; rc=$?; node test/pairing-guard.js verify && exit $rc || exit 1
scripts.dist: npm run dist:arm64 && npm run dist:x64
scripts.dist:arm64: node scripts/build-binaries.mjs arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-dmg.mjs arm64
scripts.dist:x64: node scripts/build-binaries.mjs amd64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-dmg.mjs x64
scripts.modal-check: npm run build && node test/pairing-guard.js snapshot && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= ./node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron test/modal-check.js; rc=$?; node test/pairing-guard.js verify && exit $rc || exit 1
scripts.pair-check: npm run build && node test/pairing-guard.js snapshot && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= ./node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron test/pair-modal-check.js; rc=$?; node test/pairing-guard.js verify && exit $rc || exit 1
scripts.scroll-check: npm run build && node test/pairing-guard.js snapshot && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= ./node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron test/scroll-check.js; rc=$?; node test/pairing-guard.js verify && exit $rc || exit 1
scripts.why-check: npm run build && node test/pairing-guard.js snapshot && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= ./node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron test/why-check.js; rc=$?; node test/pairing-guard.js verify && exit $rc || exit 1

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Ìbejì connects to your other Mac on this network. It never sends anything to the internet.
